name: us-state-tax
description: NEW MEXICO, WHERE THE $4,000 DEPENDENT DEDUCTION PAYS NOTHING FOR AN ONLY CHILD: NMSA 1978 7-2-39 allows it "for each dependent IN EXCESS OF ONE", so a family with one child gets $0, two children get $4,000 and four get $12,000 - and every published account of the provision describes it as $4,000 a dependent, which overstates the deduction by exactly $4,000 at EVERY family size, $172.00 to $236.00 of tax depending on the band; confirmed against a filled PIT-1, where a household with $200,000 of AGI, $40,000 of federal itemized deduction and THREE dependents has $152,000 of New Mexico taxable income and not $148,000; where the deduction belongs to TWO of the five filing statuses, a single filer, a married filer filing separately and a SURVIVING SPOUSE getting nothing although the state gives her a box of her own and sends her to the joint RATE column; where 7-2-7 writes THREE rate schedules and not five, grouping married-filing-jointly, surviving spouses and HEADS OF HOUSEHOLD under one, so a model that defaults a head of household to the single column overcharges by $202.00 at $66,500 of net taxable income, $269.00 from $100,000 to $210,000 and A FLAT $1,319.00 AT EVERY INCOME ABOVE $315,000, forever, because the single column's 5.9% band opens $105,000 earlier; where the SOCIAL SECURITY EXEMPTION IS A LIVE CLIFF with no taper - the whole federally taxable benefit exempt where federal AGI does not exceed $100,000 single, $150,000 joint, head of household or surviving spouse, $75,000 separate, and NONE of it one dollar above, which is $2,855.65 of tax on a couple with $60,000 of benefit and $3,961.85 with $85,000, the largest live Social Security discontinuity in this package, measured over every state in it; where THOSE THREE FIGURES ARE NOT INDEXED although a published 2026 guide says they are, HB 249 of 2024 having been postponed indefinitely on 6 February 2024; where the low- and middle-income exemption is $2,500 PER FEDERAL EXEMPTION and not per return, so a joint return with two children claims four and $10,000, and its printed income limit is exactly where its own taper reaches zero and so can zero a positive exemption in no household at any income; where the aged-or-blind exemption of 7-2-5.2 has not been indexed since 1987 and its two conditions are ALTERNATIVES rather than additions, so a New Mexican who is both 65 and blind qualifies once, and four of its eight single boundaries now cost nothing at all because the federal deduction has grown past the incomes they apply at; where THE DEDUCTION IS THE FEDERAL ONE - PIT-1 line 12, Form 1040 line 12 - so the One Big Beautiful Bill Act cut New Mexico tax for tax year 2025 with no New Mexico legislation and the section 63(f) age addition reaches the return too, Missouri's answer and not Arizona's; and where the 40% capital gains deduction is GONE for everybody who did not sell a New Mexico business, HB 252 of 2024 having restricted it and raised the flat element to $2,500, so an account still applying 40% understates the tax on a $200,000 long-term gain by $4,011.50. Plus 42 states and 1,033 local income taxes across them: New York City, Yonkers, all 24 Maryland jurisdictions, all 92 Indiana counties, all 24 Michigan cities, all 679 municipalities and all 214 Ohio school districts - more taxing jurisdictions than the rest of the United States put together. Zero dependencies, MIT, ESM and CommonJS, TypeScript types included.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node scripts/finalize.mjs
